statement: Domestic and foreign business corporations must file a Biennial Statement with the New York Department of State every two years under Business Corporation Law § 408, with a $9 filing fee, during the calendar month in which the original Certificate of Incorporation or Application for Authority was filed; a corporation that fails to file shows as past due on the Department's records and on any certificate of status.
caveat: LLCs file under Limited Liability Company Law § 301(e) on the same fee and cycle; the statement cannot be filed before its due month, and most filers must use the e-Statement Filing Service. Past-due status does not by itself dissolve the corporation. Verify on the live page before filing.
